NAM.note: The AI Act and draft bill are described as AI governance and ethics, with no harm from AI or authority named.
No government use of AI is stated.

facts.fact: New Era reports that ICT Minister Emma Theofelus told Parliament Namibia is developing an Artificial Intelligence Act, and that the ministry has already developed a draft bill, per its director Frans Nghitila.

NAM.note: No AI tool in a public sector system is stated.
No national AI strategy is named; only a national AI workgroup and the AU Continental Strategy.
No AI model, dataset or computing built in Namibia is stated.

facts.fact: New Era reports the ICT ministry is finalising the Data Protection Bill.
New Era reports the ICT ministry is finalising the Data Protection Bill.
New Era says the African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection is a framework "which Namibia ratified".
facts.system: AU Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection

facts.fact: New Era says Namibia ratified the African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection.
